messages:
elyse: Heads-up — Acme reports 403s in production when calling embeddings and the new rerank endpoint after we migrated them to the org-managed API key via SCIM yesterday. They see it intermittently across services.

jay: Can you paste the exact error they get? 403 can mean billing, revoked key, or scopes.

elyse: Pasted from their logs: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` and response body: ```{\n  \"error\": \"insufficient_scope\",\n  \"message\": \"missing scopes: embeddings, rerank\"\n}``` They also have a separate 403 for generation endpoints when using the same key in some services: `missing scopes: inference.generate`

marta: Interesting — sounds like the org-key template did not include the full scope set. We recently changed the default template for SCIM-provisioned keys to a minimized set for new orgs. Could be that.

elyse: Repro steps I asked them to run:
1) set API_KEY to the org-provisioned key
2) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input": "test"}'
They ran that and got the same 403 payload above.

jay: Can we confirm whether a console/IA call shows the key scopes? Marta, is there an internal route to fetch key metadata?

marta: Yes: GET /internal/v1/keys/:key_id returns metadata (scopes, created_by, provision_method). I pulled their key metadata (redacted): ```{\n  id: \"key_XXXX\",\n  scopes: [\"logging:write\",\"billing:read\"],\n  provision_method: \"scim_provision\",\n  created_by: \"scim-service@acme.com\"\n}``` So it lacks inference/embeddings/rerank scopes.

elyse: That matches. Customer says the key was created by their IdP integration (SCIM) when we created the org-managed key. They expected full perms.

jay: Root cause looks like the SCIM provisioning flow used the new minimal scope template. We rolled that change in last week for trial orgs; looks like Acme was flagged as trial accidentally.

marta: Fix options:
- Quick fix: create a new API key for them with the correct scopes and ask them to rotate.
- Mid-term: update SCIM template to include inference, embeddings, rerank and re-provision keys for mistagged orgs.

elyse: I created key key_new_XXXXX with scopes: ["inference.generate","embeddings.create","rerank.run","logging:write","billing:read"]. Asked Acme to test. They ran the same curl and now get 200 + embeddings vector payload.

support-bot: Deploy note: patch queued to revert SCIM default template to include inference scopes for org-tier = paid. PR#3145 in eng-infra.

jay: Good. We should also add a policy/diagnostic we can run automatically when a customer hits 403 with \"insufficient_scope\" — return helpful text pointing to missing scopes and link to rotation steps. Right now error message is generic.

marta: Agreed. Action items:
- (marta) roll back SCIM template change for affected orgs (WIP).
- (elyse) coordinate key rotation with Acme and confirm no other services still use the old key.
- (jay) add an actionable error code mapping in the API gateway so 403/insufficient_scope includes which scopes are required for the attempted endpoint.

elyse: Acme confirmed after rotation: embedding calls ✅, rerank calls ✅, generation calls ✅. They rotated across three microservices and everything green.

jay: Timeline: allocating a postmortem to eng-infra. We need to know how many other orgs got the minimized template.

marta: I ran a quick query: ~14 orgs got the template in the 24h window. Reaching out to each to check if they use inference APIs.

elyse: Customer follow-up to Acme: we triggered rotation and confirmed success. Asked them to rotate again if they have any cached key copies. They were very thankful. :tada:

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042, severity: low, owner: eng-infra. Link: https://internal.redwood/infra/incidents/INC-2026-042

jay: Recommended improvements for support playbook:
- Add a quick checklist for 403s: billing check, key revoked, key scopes, org status.
- Share curl examples to show missing scopes and how to fetch key metadata.

elyse: Putting the repro and fix into a KB article draft. PR to docs repo in progress.

marta: One gotcha we saw: some SDKs mask 403 body, so support should run curl to capture exact JSON error from gateway. I added a note to the KB.

elyse: Closing thread once eng-infra confirms template rollback and we notify affected orgs. Will attach confirmation to INC-2026-042.

jay: Thanks all. Quick snippet for support KB to include (curl to introspect scopes):
```bash
# fetch key metadata (internal) - support only
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_TOKEN" https://internal.api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/key_XXXX

# reproduce external error
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"test"}'
```

elyse: Notes attached to INC. Will ping once rollback PR is merged.

support-bot: Automation: scheduled audit job created to run weekly for SCIM-provisioned keys (audit job id: audit_2026_07).
